hook.say: America's ten tallest buildings, ranked. Eight of them are in one city!

outro.say: New York or Chicago? Comment below!

items.name: Empire State Building
items.say: Number ten: the Empire State Building, once the world's tallest. 1250 feet.
items.cap: Number ten: the Empire State Building, once the world's tallest. 1,250 feet.

items.name: 30 Hudson Yards
items.fact: A sky deck over the city
items.say: Nine: Thirty Hudson Yards, with a deck over the city. 1270 feet.
items.cap: Nine: 30 Hudson Yards, with a deck over the city. 1,270 feet.

items.name: Trump Tower Chicago
items.say: Eight: Trump Tower Chicago, tied with number seven. 1388 feet.
items.cap: Eight: Trump Tower Chicago, tied with number seven. 1,388 feet.

items.name: 270 Park Avenue
items.say: Seven: Two-seventy Park Avenue, the brand new one. 1388 feet.
items.cap: Seven: 270 Park Avenue, the brand new one. 1,388 feet.

items.name: 432 Park Avenue
items.say: Six: Four-thirty-two Park Avenue, a pencil-thin tower. 1396 feet.
items.cap: Six: 432 Park Avenue, a pencil-thin tower. 1,396 feet.

items.name: One Vanderbilt
items.say: Five: One Vanderbilt, right next to Grand Central. 1401 feet.
items.cap: Five: One Vanderbilt, right next to Grand Central. 1,401 feet.

items.name: 111 West 57th
items.say: Four: One-eleven West Fifty-seventh, the world's skinniest skyscraper. 1428 feet.
items.cap: Four: 111 West 57th, the world's skinniest skyscraper. 1,428 feet.

items.name: Willis Tower
items.say: Three: Willis Tower, also once the world's tallest. 1451 feet.
items.cap: Three: Willis Tower, also once the world's tallest. 1,451 feet.

items.name: Central Park Tower
items.say: Two: Central Park Tower, the tallest homes on Earth. 1550 feet.
items.cap: Two: Central Park Tower, the tallest homes on Earth. 1,550 feet.

items.name: One World Trade
items.say: And number one: One World Trade Center! 1776 feet, a nod to independence.
items.cap: And number one: One World Trade Center! 1,776 feet, a nod to independence.
